fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) stock is currently at $690, up 201% over the past year and 598% over 18 months, but down approximately 43% from summer all-time high.
fields.summary_ko.1: Micron's revenue growth is directly tied to pricing power of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), currently recording exceptionally high gross margin of 87%, but faces risk of price and profit collapse after 2028 due to potential supply surplus.
